scientific_constraints: Missing modalities are excluded from fusion.
Missing modalities are not assigned probability zero.
Reliability weights must be derived from validation performance.
Test performance must not be used to derive reliability weights.
Independent modality datasets must not be artificially row-matched.
The current three modality samples are not a valid paired multimodal evaluation.
